metadata.title: fix(gateway-service): invalidate tools/resources/prompts caches on update and delete
metadata.author: gandhipratik203

description:
## Related Issue

Closes #3526

## Summary

`update_gateway` and `delete_gateway` only called `invalidate_gateways()` after a successful operation. The tools, resources, and prompts registry caches were never invalidated, so callers could see stale federated data until those caches expired on their own TTL.

<details>
<summary>Change details</summary>

Added `invalidate_tools()`, `invalidate_resources()`, and `invalidate_prompts()` calls immediately after the existing `invalidate_gateways()` call in both `update_gateway` (post-commit) and `delete_gateway` (post-commit).

Updated all test mocks that stub `_get_registry_cache` to expose the three new async methods, preventing `TypeError: object MagicMock can't be used in 'await' expression` in existing tests.

</details>

---

commits.message:
fix(gateway-service): invalidate tools/resources/prompts caches on update and delete

update_gateway and delete_gateway only invalidated the gateways cache
after a successful operation. Tools, resources, and prompts served via
the registry cache could remain stale until their own TTL expired,
causing callers to see outdated data after a gateway change.

Add invalidate_tools(), invalidate_resources(), and invalidate_prompts()
calls alongside the existing invalidate_gateways() call in both paths.

Update all test mocks that stub _get_registry_cache to include the three
new async methods so existing tests continue to pass.

Closes #3526

Signed-off-by: Pratik Gandhi <gandhipratik203@gmail.com>
